svg.title: Blot K1 runtime before and after

cc:Work.dc:title: Blot K1 runtime before and after
cc:Work.dc:description: Paired runtime as a percentage of the previous K1, separately for default and optimizing-only V8. Generic integer: 22.0% and 20.6%; generic F32: 81.3% and 84.7%. Ordinary and eight-byte aggregate controls remain approximately unchanged. Whiskers show all five pairs, not confidence intervals.
